.. py:data:: MAX_PROBLEM_PCT
   :value: 10.0


.. py:function:: diagnose_problematic_values(df: pandas.DataFrame, feature_cols: list[str]) -> pandas.DataFrame

.. py:function:: cleaning_and_imputation(features_df: pandas.DataFrame, datasetConfig: datasets_util.naming_conventions.DatasetConfig, modality: str = '') -> pandas.DataFrame

   Remove problematic values (NaN, +Inf, -Inf) from the features DataFrame, impute missing values, and return a cleaned DataFrame.
   This function also generates a report of problematic values and saves it to a CSV file.
   Also remove columns with too many problematic values (more than MAX_PROBLEM_PCT).
   Finally, it removes constant columns and adds back metadata columns and the target column.


.. py:function:: old_remove_missing_data(df: pandas.DataFrame, drop_rows: bool = True, drop_cols: bool = False, inplace: bool = False) -> pandas.DataFrame

   Remove rows and/or columns containing any missing values.

   :param df: Input DataFrame
   :type df: pd.DataFrame
   :param drop_rows: If True, drop rows with any NaN
   :type drop_rows: bool
   :param drop_cols: If True, drop columns with any NaN
   :type drop_cols: bool
   :param inplace: If True, modify df in place
   :type inplace: bool

   :returns: Cleaned DataFrame (or None if inplace=True)
   :rtype: pd.DataFrame


.. py:function:: old_find_duplicate_columns(df: pandas.DataFrame) -> List[str]

   Returns a list of column names that appear more than once in the DataFrame.


.. py:function:: old_duplicate_column_counts(df: pandas.DataFrame) -> pandas.Series

   Returns a Series with counts of duplicated column names (only those >1).
